title: Lonely Pixel I
goal: Solve Lonely Pixel I: Find black pixels that are the only black pixel in their row and column.
strategy: Find black pixels that are the only black pixel in their row and column.
edgeCases: A black pixel qualifies only when both its entire row and entire column contain exactly one black pixel.
inputRules: picture must be a non-empty 2D array
picture rows must be non-empty arrays
picture rows must be equal-length arrays of 'B' or 'W'
